The '''Pandemonium Cave''' is located on the north end of [[The Pandemonium]]. It is a small cave populated by [[rat]]s, [[giant rat]]s, [[spider]]s, [[giant spider]]s, and [[deadly red spider]]s.

There are ores close to the bank chest outside, namely eight [[lead rocks]] important for [[Sailing]] upgrades, and also three [[tin rocks]], three [[copper rocks]], and five [[iron rocks]] (including a [[power-mining]] location). There are also two spawns of [[bones]], three spawns of [[red spiders' eggs]], one [[rope]] spawn, and one [[bronze mace]] spawn in the cave, along with a permanent fire. 

[[Chartin' Charles McAtless]] can be found just past the entrance. He is the target of a [[spyglass]] [[Sea charting]] task. Near the mining area of the cave is a locked chest, which can be opened with the [[Stormy key]] from a [[The Tempor Tantrum|barracuda trial]] and contains the [[Storm cruiser's outfit]].

Just outside the cave entrance is a [[sea charting]] task location, and a key for a [[salvaging station schematic|buried schematic]].
